"Who punctuates and capitalizes an utterance like 'Fuuuuuuuck.'?"

i would

But yeah, to be honest, I'm a huge stickler for grammar and capitalization in my texts. My friends say they can tell when I'm rushed or agitated, since that's when I start slipping up and abbreviating.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Much appreciated!
Some background info on this- the people in this particular GoI, when contacted by higher-ups, must say "Ready and capable" if they believe they are so. Variations include "Busy but capable" and "Ready but incapable", the second of which is gonna get someone pissed at you. It's a status report and a report of status, heh.
So she's essentially making fun of the phrase they all have to say to the higher-ups, which is part of the reason the title mentions the "very different tones."
/end background rant
Please feel free to use it, though. It's one of my favorites too. : )

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Hahahahahaha holy shit the amount of hoops and communication loop-de-loops I had to set up to get this one done.
Thanks again to my teammates Silber and Vince- Silber especially on this one, because he reformatted the format as I got the pieces to him. Thanks to Randomini for letting us fuck with his MC&D format, and for literally going HOLY SHIT when he first saw it (partially because we fucked up, but you know, whatever.)
Thanks to my incredibly nerdy friend who redid the logo for me, TildeGraphics. No he is not on the site, but if you want to contact him I'm sure he will be thrilled to take your money through me. : P (I got lucky- licensing laws and friendship bonus. I only owe him a hug. Sweet!)
It's short, it sticks within the guidelines, it's a hella fancy MC&D piece with conversations from normal people in an unknown GoI. Who are they? Why have they flown under the radar for so long? Why ham???
These questions and more may or may not be answered. For now, I'm going the fuck to sleep.
- Cadence
